WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. Each winning combination of matching symbols creates a winning way. The number of possible ways in this game is 1024. Please consult the paytable for t

modes.name: RESPINS

modes.effects: Every time the player wins on a band member symbol, that member is highlighted and a respin is triggered. Win on all band members in the same round to activate the free spin feature.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: Win on all band members in the same round in the main game to trigger the free spin feature with 12 free spins.
modes.effects:
Win on all band members in the same round in the main game to trigger the free spin feature with 12 free spins. In the free spins mode, each band member symbol has a multiplier associated with it.
Every time you win on a band member symbol, the currently displayed multiplier is multiplied with the win. Before the next spin, the multiplier grows with 4x.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Welcome to a music concert featuring The Respinners! The Respinners is a 5x4 video game with 1024 ways to win and a max win of 5150x. This game is loaded with respins, a crowd goes wild feature and free spins!

 RESPINS

 Every time the player wins on a band member symbol, that member is highlighted and a respin is triggered. Win on all band members in the same round to activate the free spin feature.

 THE CROWD GOES WILD

 The crowd goes wild feature is activated randomly in the main game. Once activated, a random number of wild symbols are added for up to 12 added wilds!
